description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have Dread Slaver deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dread Slaver, adding {C}{C}.
When Dread Slaver dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
